text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while walking down the tree-lined 
path of the academy, I tripped over 
something—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Somehow I managed to regain my balance and 
avoid falling. Just as I breathed a sigh 
of relief—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Ah—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I noticed Red Desire tripping over 
something just like I did. Look out—!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Are you alright? Both of you...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Cafe-san...! Thank you for taking my hand.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
No... But they are still "there"... so 
please be careful...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I strained my eyes, but there was 
absolutely nothing to be seen. I wondered 
if it was something only visible to her, 
but—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Oh my—! Fufu♪

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
A little leprechaun, right at our feet. 
What a lovely beard.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Today they're... oh, digging a tunnel, 
aren't they? How just like you diligent 
folks.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Seeing you devote yourself to your daily 
duties reminds me of myself. I, too, must 
walk the path of the saint with great care 
and devotion.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Yes. If you believe with all your heart 
through the mind's eye of a saint, 
something will become visible—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: ...Or at least, that is how it feels.
choice_data_list:
(I don't think that counts as seeing it, 
though...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—I thought to myself, but managed to 
swallow my words.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Be that as it may, this is a path where 
people come and go. It would be dangerous 
for them to work here like this.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Come now, let us head over there. —Follow 
my guidance, little ones.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To let the leprechauns (?) escape, Red 
Desire walked over toward the shrubbery.
choice_data_list: So, um... was there really a leprechaun?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...It was a shadow... like a frilled 
lizard...
choice_data_list: A shadow like a frilled lizard...?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Completely different—! It seems Red Desire 
really couldn't see it after all...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
But, fufu... it seemed to have taken a 
liking to her... and grew quite 
attached...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
What matters most to them... surely... is 
not just whether one can truly see them or 
not... but—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Whether you believe in their existence... 
and acknowledge them.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
In other words, as long as you have a 
believing heart, you can bring about small 
moments of fortune—perhaps that is what it 
means.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Those little ones have safely relocated to 
a place of tranquility. You need not worry 
anymore.
choice_data_list: So... is it safe to walk now?

Somehow, I kind of hope you stay just the 
way you are.

Somehow, I kind of hope you stay just the 
way you are.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:

a place of tranquility. You need not worry 
anymore.
choice_data_list: So... is it safe to walk now?

Somehow, I kind of hope you stay just the 
way you are.

Somehow, I kind of hope you stay just the 
way you are.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It is perfectly fine for you to walk— 
—Ah.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Right next to your right foot. There is a 
tiny tunnel there, so please just be 
careful of that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The mind's eye of a saint—in other words, 
a heart that strongly believes. I feel 
like that pure innocence is something she 
should never lose.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Of course. In order to reach "that 
land"— I shall continue to devote myself 
as a saint.
